title: Nadir (saga)
start: Find the damaged device while raiding the 18-22 furnished floors of Daemonheim, then ask Skaldrun south-west of the Daemonheim entrance to share their story.
prereq_other: Find and free Skaldrun from the frozen floors in Daemonheim

items.t: Ring of kinship to find the damaged device
Standard spells must be used for completing this saga

recommended.t: Persistent Rage relic power may trivialise some of this content

kills.t: Several soldiers (level 21 and 62) (appearance and number of the former depends on answering questions correctly)
Several rangers (level 21 and 62) (appearance of the former depends on answering questions correctly)
Two necromancers (level 105) (appearance depends on answering questions correctly), which will summon
Several zombies (level 21) (can be ignored and will despawn when the necromancers are defeated)

rewards.t: Abridged: An abridged book, which when read, gives
Ability to purchase Furniture plans: Tied ritual marker from the Daemonheim Rewards shop for 50,000 tokens (requires having purchased Furniture plans: Ritual marker at level 75 Construction)
Unabridged: Together, with the above rewards, an unabridged book, which when read, gives
Ability to purchase Furniture plans: Warped ritual marker from the Daemonheim Rewards shop for 100,000 tokens (requires having purchased Furniture plans: Ritual marker at level 75 Construction)

steps.t: Start by finding a damaged device on Daemonheim floors 18-22.

sub.t: You might need to talk to Skaldrun to check whether the Nadir saga is already unlocked.

steps.t: Then start saga with Skaldrun south-west of the Daemonheim entrance.
Wait approximately one minute for Zemouregal and Lucien to finish their conversation.
Finish the dialogue and cutscene then continue north to interrogate the merchant.
Hunt for 3 memories (having sound turned on helps a lot here).

sub.t: Move your mouse around until the orange circle rapidly pulses THREE times per second on a location, and click, as this is a correct spot. There are three speeds--you want to click at the fastest, highest-pitched ping. Repeat until all three memories are recovered.
If only half the memory is recovered, you did not do this step correctly and as a result an unabridged tome will not be awarded, you can lobby to restart the saga.

A pinging sound will play if game sounds are turned on: a slow hum (level 1), a moderately fast ping (level 2, indicating you are close to the correct position), and a fast, high-frequency ping that plays ~2 times a second. This is the correct location for full memory retrieval.
The correct location does not always correspond to the centre of a memory you can see. It can also be an empty space.
Note: On mobile, there is a bug, read the full article to find out how to deal with this.

steps.t: Continue north and climb down the dungeon entrance.
Continue east through the door.
Attempt to pass the captain.
Probe 3 memories again.
Continue through the east door, then the south door.

sub.t: You will enter a room full of guards. After some dialogues, enter the south room.

steps.t: Head north through the door and about half way into the room to get a message then leave the same way.
Continue south through the door and finish dialogue with the soldier.

sub.t: Select "Got something to get off your chest, soldier? Be my guest."

steps.t: Continue south and then west and finish dialogue with the mage.

sub.t: Select "Ask me later, Druf. I have no time for you right now."

steps.t: Continue south through the door and finish dialogue with the soldier.

sub.t: Select "Tell them to wait there, and no practice until I return."

steps.t: Continue east.

sub.t: If you enter combat in this room then you have failed the dialogue options above, restart from checkpoint.

steps.t: Continue east, south, and south.
Probe 3 memories again.
Kill the necrolord and continue south.
Head east and east again. Walk into the centre of the room with bodies. Continue west to view a cutscene.
Exit the room and continue south, then finish the dialogue with the necrolord.
Continue south, west and finish dialogue with the necrolord again.

sub.t: Select "Kill him, or I will kill you."

steps.t: Continue west and move into the room. You will move toward both portals and drain their power.
Continue south and finish the dialogue with the necrolord.

sub.t: Select "His body is on the floor above. Fetch it yourself, I am busy."

steps.t: Continue east.

sub.t: If you enter combat in this room then you have failed the dialogue options above, restart from checkpoint.

steps.t: Continue east and drain BOTH portals.
Continue south, then east.
Kill the Hooved Mage and then drain the portal.
Continue east, kill the four soldiers and two rangers, and then continue east.
Drain the power from the portal, then head south and kill the two rangers and three soldiers.
Head east, drain the north west portal and unlock the silver shield door.
Continue east and kill the three soldiers, one ranger, and one mage. Drain the portal power.
Continue south, drain the portal.
Continue south, kill the two hellhounds and two soldiers, drain the portal, then unlock the green pentagon door.
Continue west and kill the three soldiers, one ranger, and one mage. Drain both portals.
Continue west and watch the cutscene.

sub.t: Your adrenaline will stay constant and will no longer drain. Your adrenaline may drain during the following cutscene, but full completion is still awarded.

steps.t: Continue east, continue dialogue and investigate the ritual marker. [Chat: Any]

Talk to Bilrach. [Chat: 5 Why is the Ritual Marker here? › 4 What is this place? What is it for? › 3 How long have you been here? › 2 Tell me of the portals and their power. › 1 How did you know I was talking to Lucien? › 5 What happens now? › Any]
Saga complete!
